_meta.instructions: Select only task-relevant Skills by name and description, load each selected source, and re-evaluate when the task materially changes. If none match, continue without a Skill. Canonical Skill sources remain authoritative.

name: adudeck-deck-build
description: Orchestrate incremental deck implementation through calibration slices, reviewed increments, integration review, and completion; not curriculum decisions or prose/playground ownership.

name: adudeck-deck-curriculum
description: Design or audit one deck's internal learning contract: scope, learner prerequisites, outcomes, concept dependencies, unit sequence, and curriculum deltas; not deck implementation or workspace metadata ownership.

name: adudeck-playground
description: Design or review executable learning playgrounds that expose mechanisms through observable state and controlled experiments; not textbook prose or curriculum ownership.

name: adudeck-textbook
description: Define or review textbook structure, depth, exercises, and instructional quality; use adudeck-textbook-write for actual prose authoring.

name: adudeck-textbook-write
description: Write or deeply revise textbook prose, examples, exercises, and assessments from an established scope; not curriculum research or playground design.

name: clarify-code
description: Clarify existing code, names, contracts, rationale, or control flow without changing behavior; not features, correctness review, optimization, or redesign.

name: guidance-context
description: Adapt teaching, coaching, or walkthrough support when the learner's goal, state, constraints, or progress materially changes how guidance should work; not ordinary explanation.

name: mols-agent-asset
description: Create, refactor, or simplify agent Rules, Skills, instructions, or agent definitions; use validator for formal evaluation and find for discovery/install/sync.

name: mols-agent-asset-find
description: Discover, select, load, install, update, or sync Agent Assets; not behavior authoring or formal validation.

name: mols-agent-asset-validator
description: Audit, stress-test, validate, or evidence-led improve bounded agent assets, routing, orchestration, and eval behavior; not ordinary product-code or prose review.

name: mols-chatbot-bootstrap
description: Provision, repair, or review minimal CHATBOT.md compatibility into AGENTS, Skill, and Rule discovery; not unrelated routing, tuning, or CI work.

name: mols-ci-design
description: Design or review lightweight risk-proportional CI, validation routing, and evidence boundaries; do not implement workflows unless explicitly requested.

name: mols-markdown-for-human
description: 사람이 빠르게 읽고 이해할 수 있도록 Markdown의 정보 구조와 표현을 작성하거나 개선한다.

name: mols-markdown-maintenance
description: Run deterministic Markdown formatting, frontmatter, link, heading, or index maintenance; not prose judgment or document semantics.

name: mols-mermaid-chart
description: Create quantitative Mermaid charts for magnitude, trend, proportion, quantified flow, weighted hierarchy, profiles, or normalized positioning; use diagram for structural relations.

name: mols-mermaid-diagram
description: Create Mermaid diagrams for procedures, structure, states, handoffs, sequence, dependencies, models, or hierarchy; use chart when quantitative comparison is primary.

name: mols-rpi
description: Run iterative Research → Plan → Implementation → Review with bounded loops for complex or explicitly recursive work; not trivial tasks or mechanical repetition.

name: technical-document-fidelity
description: Preserve meaning, code, identifiers, URLs, and meaningful structure when rewriting or reformatting an existing technical document; not new-document authoring.
